newsitem.title: USA: Boston Life tumor-related tests effective.
newsitem.headline: Boston Life tumor-related tests effective.

text.p: Boston Life Sciences Inc said Monday its anti-angiogenic factor was effective in limiting the growth of blood vessels in an animal study.
A successful anti-angiogenic agent would be helpful in treating tumor cancers, which depend on new blood vessel development to grow, the company said.

The company said its study found significantly less blood vessel formation in the corneas of mice whose eyes had been injected with medicines to stimulate blood vessel growth, then treated with Boston Life's angiogenic factor.

"The apparently successful systemic delivery of anti-angiogenic factor together with our earlier success in cloning and producing this factor now enable us to acclerate our pre-clinical development and scale-up production plans," Boston Life Chief Executive David Hillson said.
